chapter: Benny Meroff and Chicago's jazz scene
title: How he was hired by Benny Meroff
summary: A one-night wedding job in Bobby Meeker's Drake Hotel band puts him in front of Meroff, who hires him for his thirty-piece theater band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Okay then how did Benny Meroff come about?
Well, it's a little early for him---
Yeah-- because I jogged around for quite awhile and there was band at the Drake Hotel. A fellow that I knew very well and a lovely guy and he had been at

that hotel at the Drake Hotel -- he had been playing there for something like - say - 15 years and he had a real society sounding hotel band. And, so, I got a call --- I got a call from either the Benson Office or one of the other offices at that time in Chicago -- it's a big one - and, uh, anyway, I got a call from one of the offices and they wanted to know if I would take a job with Bobby Meeker for one night only and, so, I was delighted at the money they paid because what he was doing is that big, big wedding party - where he added two trumpets to his band; he added an extra saxophone and a guitar and all this stuff -- so it's a big sounding band. And, I went down there and there was a guy - it just happened that this guy was Benny Meroff, who had a big theater orchestra in Chicago and---
He was a pretty famous band leader at that time---

Oh, boy - yes - a big money guy. And, he heard me play jazz choruses and he was looking for somebody just like me. And, he asked me if I would be interested. Well, who the hell wouldn't, to go with his big 30 piece symphony orchestra-styled band - you know - playing jazz -- he had a band within a band -- he had a dance band and he had a concert band and you played everything. And, so, I grabbed that. I couldn't resist that because that was something very special.
